title: Data Center Engineer
summary: Data center engineers install and look after the physical servers, network gear and cabling in a data center or colocation site (a building that rents rack space). They work on-site, often in shifts, fixing hardware faults and supporting remote IT, network and facilities teams.
dailyDuties: Rack and stack new servers and network devices
Run, label and test copper and fibre cables
Replace failed disks, memory and power supplies
Raise and return faulty parts with vendors
Work incident and change tickets in shift
Do daily floor checks of racks, power and cooling alerts
Keep rack layouts and asset records up to date

skills.expectation: Rack and stack servers, run copper and fibre cabling, and replace failed parts with vendor RMAs
Install and check a server operating system after hardware work
Install and check a server operating system after hardware work
Set IP addresses, test links and trace basic network faults
Patch and configure switch ports and VLANs
Work incident and change tickets and follow change windows
Hand over shifts clearly and update remote teams and vendors
Watch alerts for power, temperature and device health
Bring up hosts in VMware or Hyper-V clusters
Connect and swap disks in storage arrays and SAN switches
Coordinate hardware vendors and colocation providers

groups.label: A server operating system (Linux or Windows Server)

certifications.why: Shows the switching and cabling basics asked in most posts
